owner.headline: Cloud operations, Linux, automation and internal technical support
owner.availability: Remote support, cloud operations, observability and junior engineering roles

narrative: I turn operational complexity into reliable systems: observable infrastructure, useful internal tools and automation that keeps humans in control.

projects.name: EstadoFlow
projects.summary: A containerized SaaS and operations platform for high-volume public-procurement discovery, qualification and workflow automation.
outcomes: Centralized opportunity intelligence and operational decision-making
Combined live relational and time-series data for traceable workflows
Built cloud infrastructure, APIs and internal tooling as one coherent system

projects.name: Vera Motors · Bid Operations
projects.summary: An automation layer for repetitive tender operations, evidence capture and higher-quality bid decisions at scale.
outcomes: Converted repetitive browser work into auditable workflows
Improved throughput while preserving human review at consequential steps
Connected extraction, ranking and operational follow-through

projects.name: Trabajo
projects.summary: A multi-candidate engine for evidence-aware job discovery, ranking, application pipelines and feedback analytics across countries.
outcomes: Separates verified facts from search-only skill inferences
Balances high-probability applications with deliberate market exploration
Models work-permit, language and compensation friction without exposing private documents

projects.name: 5Holding
projects.summary: Shared runtime and cross-cutting tenant infrastructure behind product slices and migrations.
outcomes: Separated shared runtime concerns from product-specific slices
Preserved readable paths and history during monolith categorization
Kept secrets, environment files, build output and local databases outside the published boundary

projects.name: SheriffOS
projects.summary: Authorized bug-bounty orchestration with scope and refusal rules enforced in code.
outcomes: Restricts model actions to registered structured tools
Requires human approval for intrusive levels and disables the highest level by default
Redacts secrets and writes append-only JSONL audit events

projects.name: TAR Math
projects.summary: A proof-obligation platform where proposals only count after Lean 4 kernel verification against Mathlib.
outcomes: Uses recoverable checkpointed jobs and replayable event state
Compiles proof attempts in networkless, resource-capped containers
Rejects open goals, sorry, admit and new axioms

projects.name: ISPT+
projects.summary: Written and numerical exploration of a damping operator on Sobolev-Gevrey spaces.
outcomes: Built shell-model and spectral numerical probes
Uses plots to challenge the inequality rather than decorate it
Publishes no claim of a completed mathematical result

projects.name: Malware Research
projects.summary: High-level study of malicious-software behaviour, propagation and financial-malware architecture in isolated environments.
outcomes: Studies behaviour deeply enough to reason about detection and defence
Keeps research isolated and sandboxed
Publishes no payloads, evasion, persistence, bypass or infection procedures

principles: Private data never belongs in a public client bundle
